item.title: Check out Dirty Heads' new upbeat track "One of Those Days" - X1039
item.description: Dirty Heads are back with a new single, featuring a laid-back, sun-drenched reggae-rock vibe about enjoying good times with friends. The track, which features both Duddy B and Dirty J, is from their upcoming ninth album, "7 Seas" expected in June. Plus, they're coming back to Colorado! June 25 at Red Rocks and June 26 at Dillon Amphitheater!
